description: Search-strength record: kibitzer MCTS+value vs Stockfish (UCI_LimitStrength, Elo 1320 floor; STOCKFISH_TIME=0.05s). Score = (W + 0.5*D)/games from kibitzer's perspective. Standard error of a 20-game score is ~0.09, so points within ~0.1 of each other are NOT distinguishable.

opponent.note: 1320 is the FLOOR of Stockfish UCI_LimitStrength; a weaker limited opponent cannot be requested.

prior_runs_n10_flagged.note: earlier dead-end checkpoint, N=10, not comparable
earlier dead-end checkpoint, N=10, not comparable
N=10 pilot, superseded by the N=20 primary run at 256 sims

value_gate_offline.note: Pearson and sign accuracy are scale-invariant (comparable); R2/MSE/MAE are NOT comparable across cp vs pm1 targets.

headline_findings: Offline value metrics do NOT predict play: joint_scratch won decisive-sign by +6.67pp but did not beat baseline in games.
Search depth is the only lever that moved strength: value_final 64->256 sims lifted score 0.100->0.225.
But search-depth PLATEAUS: 256->512 sims went 0.225->0.200 (flat within noise). It is a one-shot crutch, not a path.
Even the best config tops out ~0.2 vs the weakest limited Stockfish (Elo-1320 floor).
